mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.3% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital flows into equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals economic contraction and recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to earnings deterioration fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 600 and industrial production above 100 indicate robust consumer and manufacturing demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO exceed thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 215) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.3) creates favorable equity conditions, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation and low interest rates
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: High real residential sales (RSAFS > 350,000) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through improved market sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 350,000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to deteriorating corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 130,000) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 10.0) signals labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting both PAYEMS and UNRATE thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) with persistently low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.3) creates a 'Goldilocks' environment, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 215 and FEDFUNDS is below 0.3.
